verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own MCP docs say agents can integrate file system access through MCP servers, and runtime server management is documented. Its built-in code execution is a sandboxed Code Interpreter rather than an exec surface on the user's machine, so local file editing depends on plugging in an external MCP server. missing for 10: documented local shell or command execution, a first-party file-edit tool for the host machine, hands-on corroboration of local file editing via MCP.
